Very impressed with how good this feels to play. From the Directional Air Dash to the Parries everything feels very crisp and great to control. The animation work on enemies is genuinely outstanding as well. Attacks are very intuitive to read and don't require you to just learn patterns by memory. The very high quality on most animations does make it noticeable when something isn't quite at the same level (the death animation when you fall in a pit for example), but I think speaks more so to how well everything else is done when something sticks out by just being 'okay'.

Recommended. A half-hour first-person shooter/melee hybrid from a single developer, priced as a game but openly a tech demo, and the craft inside it justifies the price.

Ray-traced fire, water reflections and lightning-drenched ruins come from one person, the power sandbox (EMP launches, grapple pulls, lightning, time freeze, sword combos) reshapes every encounter, and the shotgun fires as fast as the trigger can be pulled. Purchased skills persist across runs, and costumes plus collectibles pad the replay.

The final boss crams a bullet-reflecting scrap into the smallest arena in the game, a grapple into an ammo pickup can soft-lock a speedrun through the floor of the world, and 26 to 35 minutes of content ends unresolved. Judge it as the demo it is and it plays better than its scope has any right to allow.

Cyberpunk 2077 succeeded in creating one of the best worlds I’ve ever seen in any video game. Night City is rich and dark, fun and scary at the same time, with so much to do and countless secrets waiting to be discovered. The way everything unfolds in the city feels incredibly immersive.

The base game had some issues. The main story was good, but it felt somewhat lacking at times, and I felt the same way about some of the side quests. Phantom Liberty fixed most of my issues with the game.
It delivers an amazing story with complex characters, well-written side quests, and plenty of activities to do.

I really enjoyed my time in Cyberpunk 2077 and learned a lot throughout the experience. I’ll definitely miss its characters, atmosphere, and everything Night City has to offer.

However, I love the look of it cause it's like those old PS2 games honestly. I've seen worse graphics. This game is fun and we bought it on a sale.
